name: Harry Potter at Universal Studios Florida
intro: Diagon Alley is the Harry Potter land that Disney wished it had built — a fully enclosed, weather-tight world hidden behind a King's Cross station facade, anchored by the best dark ride in Florida. Everything here works together: ride Gringotts, explore Knockturn Alley, grab a Butterbeer, then board the Hogwarts Express to Hogsmeade.

rides.blurb: The reason you're here. Book your Express Pass for this or commit to rope drop — the difference between a 20-minute and 90-minute wait is which side of 9 am you show up.
The train ride is a full narrative experience, not a shuttle — the story in your compartment window is entirely different on the return trip. Park-to-park ticket required.
